title: Vanaras deliverance from black hole
introduction: Vanara-s deliverance from black hole is effectuated by Sainted Lady Swayamprabha. On listening to Hanuma about the plight of monkeys by which they entered this cavity in searching for Seetha, Sainted Lady Swayamprabha becomes sympathetic and offers guestship. When entreated by Hanuma for an exit from that incarceration, and as the time frame set by Sugreeva is lapsed in this very cavity, Swayamprabha uses her ascetic powers to transport the monkeys from that cave, which exit is otherwise impossible for any other intruder, in his aliveness.
closing: The episode of Swayamprabha is usually taken as a matter of fact scene, and almost un-commentated by ancient commentators, but it has some bearing on the import of the famous Vedic saying a-sato mā sat-gamaya, tamaso mā jyotir gamaya, mṛtyor mā a-mṛtam gamaya 'from unreality lead me unto reality, from darkness lead me unto light, from mortality lead me unto immortality...' Here the monkeys on duty have entered a black hole, saw an unreal world, and are on the verge of hunger-deaths, and they want release from the three, viz., darkness, unreality and death. Then a real being Swayamprabha, with her own self-luminosity appeared and gave them the real food, saved them from mortality and led them to luminance from 'their' darkness, rather than from the 'cavity's' darkness.

The entry of monkeys into a gloom is the pathless search in their duty, seeing an unreal world is deeming their search as unreal, rather meaningless, and hunger-death is not in their physical aspect, it is the hungering for finding Seetha, as Swayamprabha alone says tarasvinaḥ vānarāḥ ' mighty monkeys...' as such they are they can sustain for some more days or months without food, but they are mortal and their hope of finding Seetha is now subjected to mortality. In view of these facts they needed a torch, a beacon, a blind-lamp in blinding darkness, called a 'way-out for Seetha's search...'

Hanuma is not that diffident a monkey to speak very humble pleasantries as at verses 16 and 17. He addressed the sainted lady, 'as you have led us to light from darkness, also saved us from physical deaths, lead us unto reality, truth, a correct way to reach our destination and let this dying hope in search become immortal in finding Seetha...' Accordingly, Swayamprabha being a godsend transported them to the southerly side of the cavity, avoiding other directions. If they are transported to northern side they have to return to Kishkindha, only to die at the hand of Sugreeva. Why she has transported them to southern side is because, she is sarvajña an 'all-knower...' knower of past, present and the future course of Ramayana. On this southern side there is an ocean and whether to cross it or die on that seashore is up to the monkeys. As a torchbearer and illuminator of the gloomy thoughts of monkeys, her role-play is over and she retunes to her cavity. In the next few chapters the monkeys quarrel among themselves, but Hanuma is the only one to learn lesson from Swayamprabha's action in transporting them to this end of ocean, takes lead in future events. Hence, Swayamprabha led Hanuma to the three positives, the truth, luminescence, and liveness of their mission.
इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे द्वि पंचाशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 52nd chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अथ तान् अब्रवीत् सर्वान् विश्रांतान् हरि यूथपान् |
इदम् वचनम् एकाग्रा तापसी धर्म चारिणी
verses.iast:
atha tān abravīt sarvān viśrāṃtān hari yūthapān |
idam vacanam ekāgrā tāpasī dharma cāriṇī
verses.translation: When those monkey commanders are relaxed after refreshments, then that sainted lady, who concentrates single-mindedly and who is a pursuer of probity, spoke this word to all of them.

glosses.meaning: she who in probity, pursuer of

verses.devanagari:
वानरा यदि वः खेदः प्रनष्टः फल भक्षणात् |
यदि च एतत् मया श्राव्यम् श्रोतुम् इच्छामि कथताम्
verses.iast:
vānarā yadi vaḥ khedaḥ pranaṣṭaḥ phala bhakṣaṇāt |
yadi ca etat mayā śrāvyam śrotum icchāmi kathatām
verses.translation: "Oh, vanara-s, if your enervation is eased off by devouring fruits, and if I may listen to that episode of yours, I wish to listen to it." Thus Swayamprabha addressed the monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
तस्याः तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुत आत्मजः |
आर्जवेन यथा तत्त्वम् आख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā hanumān māruta ātmajaḥ |
ār.hjavena yathā tattvam ākhyātum upacakrame
verses.translation: Hanuma, the son of Air-god, sincerely started to narrate their episode in its pithiness on hearing her words.

glosses.meaning: of hers, that, sentence, on hearing

verses.devanagari:
राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य महेन्द्र वरुण उपमः |
रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान् प्रविष्टो दण्डका वनम्
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या च अपि भार्यया |
तस्य भार्या जनस्थानात् रावणेन हृता बलात्
verses.iast:
rājā sarvasya lokasya mahendra varuṇa upamaḥ |
rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmān praviṣṭo daṇḍakā vanam
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā ca api bhāryayā |
tasya bhāryā janasthānāt rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt
verses.translation: "The king of all the world and one similar to Mahendra and Rain-god, such an illustrious Rama of Dasharatha entered Dandaka forest with his bother Lakshmana, even along with his wife Vaidehi, but Ravana coercively abducted his wife from Janasthaana.

glosses.meaning: Mahendra, Rain-god, who is similar to
along with wife, Vaidehi, even also

verses.devanagari:
वीरः तस्य सखा राज्ञः सुग्रीवो नाम वानरः |
राजा वानर मुख्यानाम् येन प्रस्थापिता वयम्
verses.iast:
vīraḥ tasya sakhā rājñaḥ sugrīvo nāma vānaraḥ |
rājā vānara mukhyānām yena prasthāpitā vayam
verses.translation: "A valiant one and the king of important vanara-s known as Sugreeva is a vanara and the friend of that kingly Rama, and that vanara king expedited us.

verses.devanagari:
अगस्त्य चरिताम् आशाम् दक्षिणाम् यम रक्षिताम् |
सहैभिर्वानरैमुख्यैरङ्गदप्रमुखैर्वयम् - यद्वा -
सह एभिः वानरैः मुख्यैः अंगद प्रमुखैः वयम्
रावणम् सहिताः सर्वे राक्षसम् काम रूपिणम् |
सीतया सह वैदेह्या मार्गध्वम् इति चोदिताः
verses.iast:
agastya caritām āśām dakṣiṇām yama rakṣitām |
sahaibhirvānaraimukhyairañgadapramukhairvayam - yadvā -
saha ebhiḥ vānaraiḥ mukhyaiḥ aṃgada pramukhaiḥ vayam
rāvaṇam sahitāḥ sarve rākṣasam kāma rūpiṇam |
sītayā saha vaidehyā mārgadhvam iti coditāḥ
verses.translation: "He mobilised us along with these important vanara-s and Angada as helmsman to this southerly prospect, which is the walkabout of Sage Agastya and watched over by Yama, the Death-god, saying, 'you all shall collectively search for Seetha of Videha kingdom together with the demon Ravana, a guise-changer by his wish.'

glosses.meaning: for one from Videha kingdom, for Seetha, together with
by wish, guise-changer, for demon, for Ravana
these, with important, vanara-s, along with
by Yama, the Death-god, watched over
to southern, prospect [direction,] we are mobilised.

verses.devanagari:
विचित्य तु वयम् सर्वे समग्रम् - समुद्रम् - दक्षिणाम् दिशम् |
वयम् बुभुक्षिताः सर्वे वृक्ष मूलम् उपाश्रिताः
verses.iast:
vicitya tu vayam sarve samagram - samudram - dakṣiṇām diśam |
vayam bubhukṣitāḥ sarve vṛkṣa mūlam upāśritāḥ
verses.translation: "On searching out the southerly direction in its entirety we are all hungered and we all gathered around at a tree-stem.

glosses.meaning: at ocean - other than southern ocean
tree, at stem, nearby, dependent on [gathered around.]

verses.devanagari:
विवर्ण वदनाः सर्वे सर्वे ध्यान परायणाः |
न अधिगच्छामहे पारम् मग्नाः चिन्ता महाअर्णवे
verses.iast:
vivarṇa vadanāḥ sarve sarve dhyāna parāyaṇāḥ |
na adhigacchāmahe pāram magnāḥ cintā mahāar.hṇave
verses.translation: "All of us were whey-faced, all of us were preoccupied with propositions, thus deluged in the depthless deep of our despair we could not overreach the other shore of our oceanic despair.

verses.devanagari:
चारयन्तः ततः चक्षुः दृष्टवन्तो महद् बिलम् |
लता पादप संछन्नम् तिमिरेण समावृतम्
verses.iast:
cārayantaḥ tataḥ cakṣuḥ dṛṣṭavanto mahad bilam |
latā pādapa saṃchannam timireṇa samāvṛtam
verses.translation: "Then straggling our eyes we perceived this wide cavity wrapped up with vines and woods and enwrapped in darkling.

glosses.meaning: with creepers, woody trees, wrapped up in
we became perceivers of - we perceived.

verses.devanagari:
अस्मात् हंसा जल क्लिन्नाः पक्षैः सलिल रेणुभिः |
कुरराः सारसाः चैव निष्पतन्ति पतत्रिणः
verses.iast:
asmāt haṃsā jala klinnāḥ pakṣaiḥ salila reṇubhiḥ |
kurarāḥ sārasāḥ caiva niṣpatanti patatriṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Swans, water-hawks, saarasa-waterfowls were coming out of this cavity drenched in water and sprinkling drops of water with the flaps of their wings.

glosses.meaning: with water, drops, [with such flapping] wings

verses.devanagari:
साधु अत्र प्रविशाम इति मया तु उक्ताः प्लवंगमाः |
तेषाम् अपि हि सर्वेषाम् अनुमानम् उपागतम्
verses.iast:
sādhu atra praviśāma iti mayā tu uktāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ |
teṣām api hi sarveṣām anumānam upāgatam
verses.translation: "I said to all of them, 'Good! Let us enter it,' while they too had some inference about the availability of water in here.

glosses.meaning: by me, on my part, fly-jumpers are, said
for them, all of them, even, indeed

verses.devanagari:
अस्मिन् निपतिताः सर्वे अपि अथ कार्य त्वरान्विताः |
ततो गाढम् निपतिता गृह्य हस्तौ परस्परम्
verses.iast:
asmin nipatitāḥ sarve api atha kārya tvarānvitāḥ |
tato gāḍham nipatitā gṛhya hastau parasparam
verses.translation: "As our task was hastening us then we all readied ourselves to fall in the cavity by tightly clasping each other's hand, and then we fell in this cavity.

glosses.meaning: by task's, haste, having [hastened by our task]
then, down, fell [readied ourselves to fall in cavity]
in it, down, fell - we fell down in this cavity.

verses.devanagari:
इदम् प्रविष्टाः सहसा बिलम् तिमिर संवृतम् |
एतत् नः कार्यम् एतेन कृत्येन वयम् आगताः
त्वाम् च एव उपगताः सर्वे परिद्यूना बुभुक्षिताः |
verses.iast:
idam praviṣṭāḥ sahasā bilam timira saṃvṛtam |
etat naḥ kāryam etena kṛtyena vayam āgatāḥ
tvām ca eva upagatāḥ sarve paridyūnā bubhukṣitāḥ |
verses.translation: "Thus we readily entered this Black Cavity, and this much is our activity in here as we all have come here by our escapade for water, and we neared you when we were ravenous and retrogressing.

glosses.meaning: this much, our, work [here in cavity]
by this, escapade [for water,] we all, have come

verses.devanagari:
आतिथ्य धर्म दत्तानि मूलानि च फलानि च
अस्माभिः उपभुक्तानि बुभुक्षा परिपीडितैः |
verses.iast:
ātithya dharma dattāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca
asmābhiḥ upabhuktāni bubhukṣā paripīḍitaiḥ |
verses.translation: "And we who are overly harassed by hunger have devoured the fruits and tubers you have offered with the grace of your hospitality.

glosses.meaning: hospitality, by grace of, offered [by you]

verses.devanagari:
यत् त्वया रक्षिताः सर्वे म्रियमाणा बुभुक्षया
ब्रूहि प्रत्युपकार अर्थम् किम् ते कुर्वन्तु वानराः |
verses.iast:
yat tvayā rakṣitāḥ sarve mriyamāṇā bubhukṣayā
brūhi pratyupakāra artham kim te kurvantu vānarāḥ |
verses.translation: "You have rescued all of us who were on the verge of hunger-deaths, and what is to be done by vanara-s for you in requital that you may please tell." Thus Hanuma spoke to that sainted lady.

glosses.meaning: with hunger, on the verge of death

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता तु सर्वज्ञा वानरैः तैः स्वयंप्रभा
प्रत्युवाच ततः सर्वान् इदम् वानर यूथपान् |
verses.iast:
evam uktā tu sarvajñā vānaraiḥ taiḥ svayamprabhā
pratyuvāca tataḥ sarvān idam vānara yūthapān |
verses.translation: When she is spoken thus by those vanara-s then that omniscient Swayamprabha replied this to all of the vanara commanders.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वेषाम् परितुष्टा अस्मि वानराणाम् तरस्विनाम्
चरंत्या मम धर्मेण न कार्यम् इह केनचित् |
verses.iast:
sarveṣām parituṣṭā asmi vānarāṇām tarasvinām
caraṃtyā mama dharmeṇa na kāryam iha kenacit |
verses.translation: "I am very happy with all of the mighty vanara-s and what I have done to you is a part of my conduct in equity, hence nothing need be done now in my favour, in the least.
notes: The other versions of Ramayana complete this chapter with this verse and place the following subject in a separate chapter.

glosses.meaning: mighty ones, with all, of vanara-s
work, no - I do not need anything.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः शुभम् वाक्यम् तापस्या धर्म संहितम्
उवाच हनुमान् वाक्यम् ताम् अनिन्दित लोचनाम् |
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ śubham vākyam tāpasyā dharma saṃhitam
uvāca hanumān vākyam tām anindita locanām |
verses.translation: When Hanuma is said that blessed word by that sainted lady in that way, that which is agreeable to propriety, then Hanuma said this sentence to her who is with an unreprovable discernment.

glosses.meaning: one who is spoken to, Hanuma
not, reprovable, eyed [rather, one with such discernment]

verses.devanagari:
शरणम् त्वाम् प्रपन्नाः स्मः सर्वे वै धर्मचारिणिम्
यः कृतः समयो अस्माकम् सुग्रीवेण महात्मना |
स तु कालो व्यतिक्रान्तो बिले च परिवर्तताम्
verses.iast:
śaraṇam tvām prapannāḥ smaḥ sarve vai dharmacāriṇim
yaḥ kṛtaḥ samayo asmākam sugrīveṇa mahātmanā |
sa tu kālo vyatikrānto bile ca parivartatām
verses.translation: "We are now under the auspices of your ladyship comporting yourself in scrupulosity. We lapsed the time stipulated for us by the noble-souled Sugreeva by our roving around in this cavity.

glosses.meaning: [we] all, auspice, we obtained [we are under]
verily, over, stepped] we lapsed it.

verses.devanagari:
सा त्वम् अस्मात् बिलात् अस्मान् उत्तारयितुम् अर्हसि |
तस्मात् सुग्रीव वचनात् अतिक्रान्तान् गत आयुषः
verses.iast:
sā tvam asmāt bilāt asmān uttārayitum ar.hhasi |
tasmāt sugrīva vacanāt atikrāntān gata āyuṣaḥ
verses.translation: "Such as you are, a righteous lady, it will be apt of you to cross us over this cavity, as we have overextended the timeframe fixed by Sugreeva, whereby our longevity itself is threatened.

glosses.meaning: such as you are - a righteous lady
that, Sugreeva's, word [order, of timeframe] overextended
from this, cavity, to crossover, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
त्रातुम् अर्हसि नः सर्वान् सुग्रीव भय शन्कितान् |
महत् च कार्यम् अस्माभिः कर्तव्यम् धर्मचारिणि
तत् च अपि न कृतम् कार्यम् अस्माभिः इह वासिभिः |
verses.iast:
trātum ar.hhasi naḥ sarvān sugrīva bhaya śankitān |
mahat ca kāryam asmābhiḥ kartavyam dharmacāriṇi
tat ca api na kṛtam kāryam asmābhiḥ iha vāsibhiḥ |
verses.translation: "Oh, prudent lady, sail all of us through. We are rendered as hesitaters with the fear from Sugreeva. We still have to achieve an admirable achievement and that deed is also left undone as we are held-up in here." Thus Hanuma spoke to her.

glosses.meaning: from Sugreeva, fear, [we who have become] hesitaters - haunted by
to sail through, apt of you

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता हनुमता तापसी वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
जीवता दुष्करम् मन्ये प्रविष्टेन निवर्तितुम् |
verses.iast:
evam uktā hanumatā tāpasī vākyam abravīt
jīvatā duṣkaram manye praviṣṭena nivartitum |
verses.translation: When Hanuma said thus that sainted lady said sentence, "I believe outgoing is impracticable for the incomers in aliveness from this cavity.

glosses.meaning: by Hanuma, thus, she who is said, sainted lady
while living, outgoing - from this cavity

verses.devanagari:
तपसः सुप्रभावेन नियम उपार्जितेन च
सर्वान् एव बिलात् अस्मात् तारयिष्यामि वानरान् |
verses.iast:
tapasaḥ suprabhāvena niyama upār.hjitena ca
sarvān eva bilāt asmāt tārayiṣyāmi vānarān |
verses.translation: "By the sublime efficacy of ascesis acquired through my practices of numerous self-restraints I wish to sail all of the vanara-s through the incarceration, called this cavity.

glosses.meaning: from this, cavity, I wish to sail them through - make you departure from cavity.

verses.devanagari:
निमीलयत चक्षून्षि सर्वे वानर पुंगवाः
न हि निष्क्रमितुम् शक्यम् अनिमीलित लोचनैः |
verses.iast:
nimīlayata cakṣūnṣi sarve vānara puṃgavāḥ
na hi niṣkramitum śakyam animīlita locanaiḥ |
verses.translation: "All of you best vanara-s shall close up your eyelids, for it is indeed impossible to attempt an exit with unclose eyes." Thus that sainted lady said to monkeys.

glosses.meaning: all of you, vanara-s, the best

verses.devanagari:
ततो निमीलिताः सर्वे सुकुमार अंगुलैः करैः
सहसा पिदधुः दृष्टिम् हृष्टा गमन कान्क्षिणः |
verses.iast:
tato nimīlitāḥ sarve sukumāra aṃgulaiḥ karaiḥ
sahasā pidadhuḥ dṛṣṭim hṛṣṭā gamana kānkṣiṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Then all of those desirers of departure are gladdened and immediately shut their eyelids, and further they lidded them with their delicately fingered hands.

verses.devanagari:
वानराः तु महात्मानो हस्त रुद्ध मुखाः तदा
निमेष अन्तर मात्रेण बिलात् उत्तारिताः तथा |
verses.iast:
vānarāḥ tu mahātmāno hasta ruddha mukhāḥ tadā
nimeṣa antara mātreṇa bilāt uttāritāḥ tathā |
verses.translation: She then sailed those noble souled vanara-s who covered their faces with their hands through that cavity barely within a minute. [4-52-29b. 30a]

glosses.meaning: with hands, blocked - covered, with faces

verses.devanagari:
उवाच सर्वान् तान् तत्र तापसी धर्म चारिणी
निःसृतान् विषमात् तस्मात् समाश्वास्य इदम् अब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
uvāca sarvān tān tatra tāpasī dharma cāriṇī
niḥsṛtān viṣamāt tasmāt samāśvāsya idam abravīt |
verses.translation: That virtuous and sainted lady on comforting all of the monkeys, who are taken out of that precarious cavity, spoke this to them at the exterior of cavity.

glosses.meaning: in righteousness, she who is conducting herself - a virtuous lady
there - at the exterior of cavity
precarious, from that [cavity,] those who came out

verses.devanagari:
एष विन्ध्यो गिरिः श्रीमान् नाना द्रुम लता आयुतः
एष प्रसवणः शैलः सागरो अयम् महा उदधिः |
स्वस्ति वो अस्तु गमिष्यामि भवनम् वानरर्षभाः |
इति उक्त्वा तत् बिलम् श्रीमत् प्रविवेश स्वयम्प्रभा
verses.iast:
eṣa vin.hdhyo giriḥ śrīmān nānā druma latā āyutaḥ
eṣa prasavaṇaḥ śailaḥ sāgaro ayam mahā udadhiḥ |
svasti vo astu gamiṣyāmi bhavanam vānararṣabhāḥ |
iti uktvā tat bilam śrīmat praviveśa svayamprabhā
verses.translation: "This one which is surrounded by diverse trees and vines is the magnificent Vindhya Mountain, this mountain is Prasravana, and this vast expanse of water is the southerly ocean. Now I wish to return to my mansion... oh, best vanara-s, let safety betide you." saying thus Swayamprabha the Sainted Lady, re-entered the ostentatious cavity, called Riksha Bila.

glosses.meaning: with diverse, trees, vines, surrounded by
this one, ocean, vast expanse, of water
to [my] mansion, I wish to go [back]
